data.narrative:
Archetype AI is a Series A-stage AI & Software company founded by Ivan Poupyrev, Brandon Barbello, Leonardo Giusti, Jaime Lien, and Nick Gillian, having raised $48M to date. The peer universe comprises 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir), with top private peers including Reflection AI, Together AI, Figure AI, and Waymo.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $96M. Peer-median analysis examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies: Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Together AI ($8.3B, Series A), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B, Series B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B, Series B). The peer median is $7.0B, with a range spanning $3.2B to $25.0B.

The triangulated analysis produces a range of $82M (low) to $8.0B (high), with a median of $3.5B. The extreme dispersion reflects material uncertainty in peer selection and stage-appropriate multipliers within the frontier AI sector. Stage-progression suggests modest near-term value accretion, while peer-median reflects the outsized valuations recently commanded by Series A AI infrastructure companies. Key uncertainties include differentiation relative to the upper-quartile peers (Reflection AI, Together AI) and whether comparable transaction multiples apply to Archetype's specific technology positioning and market traction.
